WITH group_rates AS (
  SELECT
    s.riskeval,
    SUM(sc.gbsize) / NULLIF(SUM(sc.spanmin), 0) AS rate
  FROM scans AS sc
  JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = sc.zoneref
  GROUP BY s.riskeval
),
benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(rate) AS avg_rate
  FROM group_rates
),
above AS (
  SELECT g.rate, b.avg_rate
  FROM group_rates AS g
  CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b
  WHERE g.rate > b.avg_rate
)
SELECT AVG(rate) AS average_rate,
       AVG(rate - avg_rate) AS average_excess
FROM above;
